abstract: The term "teratoid cyst" was first used by Meyer in his classification of dysontogenetic cysts of the cervicofacial region, which was based on the type of germinative layers included in the cyst wall. Sublingual location of a dermoid cyst is not common, with an incidence of 1.6%. The teratoid cyst is the least common, accounting for 1.8% of sublingual dermoid cysts, and such lesions are extremely rare in infancy. In our case, a 7-mo-old male infant was referred with a sublingual mass. Ultrasonography yielded a cystic mass with internal echoes but no specific diagnosis. The smears obtained from fine-needle aspiration (FNA) displayed sheets of large, benign-appearing, anucleated and nucleated squamous cells. There were a number of neutrophils, which had no significant importance. No atypical cells were observed. According to the clinical picture and FNA findings, it appeared to be a cystic structure of keratogenous origin and could have been any type of dermoid cyst. The cyst was excised completely by the oral approach. On histopathological examination, the presence of skin appendages along with mature cartilage and respiratory epithelium confirmed the final diagnosis of a teratoid cyst. In conclusion, although FNA is not comparable with computed tomography (CT) and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), it might be valuable for the diagnosis of lesions occurring in this anatomical location. It is safe, cost-effective, and reliable. FNA is not only able to help selecting the most appropriate surgical method, but also be used as a therapeutic modality in some emergencies or during surgery.
abstract_ja: 「奇形腫様嚢胞」という用語は、Meyerが頸顔面領域の発生異常性嚢胞を、嚢胞壁に含まれる胚葉の種類に基づいて分類した際に初めて用いられた。舌下の類皮嚢腫は稀で、発生頻度は1.6%である。奇形腫様嚢胞は舌下類皮嚢腫の1.8%と最も稀であり、乳児期にはきわめて稀である。本症例は生後7か月の男児で、舌下の腫瘤を主訴に受診した。超音波検査では内部エコーを伴う嚢胞性腫瘤を認めたが、特異的な診断には至らなかった。穿刺吸引細胞診の塗抹標本では、大型で良性の見た目の無核および有核扁平上皮細胞のシートを認めた。多数の好中球を認めたが重要な所見ではなかった。異型細胞は認めなかった。臨床像と細胞診所見から、角化性の起源をもつ嚢胞性病変であり、いずれかの類皮嚢腫の可能性があると考えられた。嚢胞は口腔アプローチで完全に摘出された。病理組織学的検査では、皮膚付属器と成熟軟骨、呼吸上皮が認められ、奇形腫様嚢胞の最終診断が確定した。結論として、穿刺吸引細胞診はCTやMRIに比べて情報量は劣るものの、この解剖学的部位の病変の診断に有用である可能性がある。安全で費用対効果が高く信頼性も高い。手術法の選択に役立つだけでなく、緊急時や手術中の治療的手段としても用いることができる。
